name: Priznanie Joske
source: Josuke notices his nephew has a crush on him. The feeling is mutual, so isn't it time to discuss it head-on? What if his hopes don't pan out? First, we need to figure out what's going on! Help Josuke get to know Jotaro better and avoid making a fool of himself on a semi-date. Get Jotaro out of the hotel or storm in. Beat around the bush or be blunt. Trust your own instincts or someone else's. Uncover Jotaro's secret or leave it at that... You are the creator of your own teenage melodrama in the JoJo setting.
translation: 仗助注意到他的侄子迷恋他。这种感觉是相互的，所以现在不正是正面讨论的时候吗？如果他的希望落空怎么办？首先我们要弄清楚到底是怎么回事！帮助仗助更好地了解承太郎，避免在半约会中出丑。让承太郎离开酒店或者冲进去。拐弯抹角或者直言不讳。相信你自己的直觉或别人的直觉。揭开承太郎的秘密，或者就此罢休……你是JoJo设定中自己的青少年情节剧的创造者。
